description: Check a draft answer's figures against the company's own filings before using them: revenue, net income, EPS, operating income, margins, growth, cash flow, assets, debt and more, for a fiscal year or quarter as the company labels it. Each claim comes back confirmed, contradicted (with the filed figure and what the claimed one matches instead: another year, a quarter, a unit slip), not reported (a period or measure the filings do not have) or not checkable.

claims.description: Claims to check, each a measure, period and value.

basis.description: Adjusted and non-GAAP figures are not in the XBRL statements and are not checked here.

growth.description: The value is growth over the prior year, in percent.

measure.description: What the figure is: revenue, net income, diluted EPS, operating income, gross profit, operating margin, net margin, free cash flow, total assets, cash, long-term debt, R&D, dividends per share...

period.description: The period as the company labels it: "fiscal 2025", "FY2025", "Q3 2026", "third quarter of fiscal 2026".

value.description: The claimed figure, as written: 416.2 with unit "USD billion"; margins and growth in percent.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193) or name: the company the claims are about.

text.description: Or a draft answer about the company: every figure in it with a measure and a period is checked.

name: verify_claims

outputSchema.description: rows are claims in the order of columns: verdict is confirmed, confirmed as first reported, contradicted, not reported or not checkable; filed is the company's figure in the claim's unit; note says what a contradicted figure matches instead.

title: Verify claims against filings
